Locate [[Blimm]] and enlist his help in getting inside [[Oola's Lab]].

== Quest information ==

=== Objectives ===
* Locate the laboratory of [[Oola]], the Asuran master golemancer.
* Find Oola's former assistant, Blimm, in [[Rata Sum]].
* Meet Blimm in [[Magus Stones]].
* Travel with Blimm to the secret entrance to Oola's Lab in Magus Stones.
* Defeat the [[Timberland Guardian|timberland guardian]] and pick a [[Vine Seed|vine seed]] from its remains to open the bridge to Oola's Lab.
* Speak to Blimm about the secret entrance to Oola's Lab.

=== Reward ===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Asura_rank|Asura reputation points]]

== Walkthrough ==
Start off by talking to Blimm in Rata Sum to update the quest. Meet him in Magus Stones (right outside Rata Sum) with the [[party]] you will need for [[The Elusive Golemancer]] (follows on). Fight your way through Magus Stones taking care about [[patrol]]s of [[Wind Rider]]s.  Wind Riders move quickly and [[aggro]]ing several [[mob]]s at once can easily result in [[healer]]s being overwhelmed. The actual Timberland Guardian is very weak since it's on its own.

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial dialogue ===
:; Lork
:: ''You'll never get this project off the ground without '''Oola'''. She's the most proficient golemancer around. Problem is that she's locked herself away in her underground '''laboratory'''. I don't know exactly where it is, but I do know someone who can take you there. However, for that information, you will owe me a favor. Deal? Okay. If you want to find Oola, speak to her former assistant, '''Blimm'''. He's a bit odd, but he knows how to find her. Look for Blimm in '''Rata Sum'''. And when I come calling for that favor, don't try to weasel out of it, [[human]]. It won't work. Remember, I'm much smarter than you.''
{{offer dialog

=== Intermediate dialogue ===
:; Blimm
:: ''Who's there? Do you have my staff? No? Oh, Lork sent you. I owe him a favor. Yeah. Yeah. I can help find Oola's workshop. It's not easy to get to, though. I should know, I helped design the security system. It's good. Really good. Heh. Meet me in Magus Stones and I'll show you the way to her lab. By the way, have you seen [[Red Asuraline Staff|my red staff]]?''

==== Magus Stones ====
:; Blimm
:: ''I didn't much like working for Oola. She moved my desk four times, and I told her not to move my desk anymore, and then she moved it into the cellar and stopped paying me. Yeah. I didn't like that.''
: '''Blimm:''' ''"We better get going. I've got important things to be doing...Asura things you humans wouldn't understand."''
: '''Blimm:''' ''"Oola created this guardian. Once you defeat it, we can cross over to her workshop. My staff might be there."''

=== Reward ===
:; Blimm
:: ''Oola didn't fire me. I quit. She moved my desk into the cellar and stopped paying me. After a couple of months, I left. I think she took my staff, too...that's why I left. I loved that staff. Someday I'm going to burn her lab down if I don't get it back. Oh yes! Well anyway, you'll find Oola's lab below all the traps. Good luck disarming them. If I had my staff I'd help you. When you're ready to enter, speak to me and I'll use this vine seed to open the path to Oola's Lab.''

== Notes ==
* If someone in your party has the quest The Elusive Golemancer, he can teleport you across Magus Stones leading directly to Timberland Guardian by talking to Blimm a short distance west from the entrance of Rata Sum.

== Trivia ==
* This quest is named after [[Wikipedia:Office Space|Office Space]], and includes several references to the film in its dialogue.
** The reward quote is a reference to Milton having his desk moved to the basement, and the staff is in place of the Swingline stapler.
** The comment about burning down the lab mirrors Milton's claim he will burn down the building if his stapler is not returned.
